seeded_failure.symptom: Testers can submit Jira bug reports without entering the application environment or build version, leading to incomplete reports.
seeded_failure.cause: The field configuration scheme in Jira has 'Environment' and 'Affects Version' marked as optional fields for the Bug issue type.
seeded_failure.fix: Update the Field Configuration in Jira to set 'Environment' and 'Affects Version' to Required for the QA project board.

seeded_failure.symptom: The automated traceability report indicates three critical requirements have zero coverage, even though test cases exist for them.
seeded_failure.cause: The requirement reference IDs in the test management tool do not match the exact key IDs in Jira due to a typo in the prefix.
seeded_failure.fix: Correct the requirement IDs in the test management tool to match the Jira story keys and re-run the coverage report.
